Hi, I’m Gavin Boss — a Applied Business Analytics student at Boston University passionate about analytics.

I have been a Intelligence analyst for roughly 8 years but am looking to transition out of the military world and into the private sector and want to expand into business analytics. I have been attending online courses through Boston University while maintaining a full time job at USCENTCOM as an All Source Analyst.

My goals include advancing my analytical toolkit outside of governement contracting with the DOD and developing expertise in business analysis.
